chapter: Kid Rena, Kelly and the old trumpeters
title: Buddy Petit
summary: Justin heard Buddy Petit mostly on advertising trucks and in parades, not at his own club.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: He's one of my favorites. How about Buddy Petit? I never got to hear him at all.

Buddy Petit was very good too. I didn't hear him too very much, not as much as I had listened to Kid Renee or even Chris Kelly because Chris Kelly used to stay out of my neighborhood there. So I used to get a chance to listen to that in practice all the time. But I understand that I think Buddy Petit, he used to work at a little place on St. Bernard Street, he used to call it Alley. And he had worked there and of course that was out of my jurisdiction and I wasn't allowed to go that far. But the only experience I had gotten was from various times where I would listen to him on the truck advertising for a dance that night or a dance that Monday night or maybe listen to him in the street parade or something like that. But in all there was a whole lot of inspiration there, very much.
